name: Nobody Wants an Explosion...
description:
...right? So when building multiblocks, make sure you keep in mind that electric machines don't like getting rain or snow on them. They'll start fires, and those fires have a chance of causing an explosion. This explosion will explode other machines, cascading until your whole base is a hole in the ground. This is one of the reasons backups are a thing. Stay safe out there!

If worse comes to worst, there is logs/Explosion.log that tracks what caused an explosion. However, this file appears to reset on world load.
